items.title: Exxon, Chevron Warn Fuel Prices to Endure as War Knocks Refining
items.summary: (Bloomberg) -- High fuel prices are likely to stick around even if oil prices drop in the coming months as the wars in Russia and Middle East leave global refining capacity critically short, ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. and Chevron Corp. warned. items.title: US Treasury intervenes to support yen through purchases - FT
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. Treasury intervened in currency markets on Friday by purchasing yen, joining Japan’s efforts to support the currency from near four-decade lows, the Financial Times reported.
